title: Implement authorized shared and personal day context
verify: Shared day exposes common material and personal day composes the same material with only the selected student's authorized progress, discussion, and financial projection.
Navigation preserves date/class/student context and guessed or cross-student access is denied server-side.
Personal grade composition consumes the Learning Progress lesson-scoped query with the stable lesson identity and server-resolved actor/context; Lesson Context never resolves homework identity.

evidence: Final bounded execute report records the FT-003-AC-004 correction: the personal page visibly renders the authorized provider grade β and the safe null state; focused rendering 2/2 and npm run check/build/test passed.

The aggregate execution evidence preserves Attempt 1 functional FAIL, Attempt 2 provider-boundary blocker, Attempt 3 provider-query correction, and Attempt 4 rendering correction as supporting history; no execute receipt was reused.

Fresh verifier-owned disposable checks passed FT-003-AC-003..AC-006: shared material, selected-student grade/attendance/discussion/finance composition, exact API/SSR navigation identity, and denied-scope non-leakage/non-mutation.

The functional evidence confirms Learning Progress receives session context, classId, lessonId, and selected student; Lesson Context supplies no homeworkId. Required npm run check/build/test gates passed.
Standalone adversarial render probe passed the exact FT-003-AC-004 grade rendering claim for β and the safe null branch; the prior rendering blocker is closed.

Focused semantic checks passed provider ownership/boundary, exact date/class/lesson/student navigation, generic API 403 and SSR denial, privacy, and state-before/state-after non-mutation; no finding was admitted.

evidence_required: FT-003-AC-003 RED: an authorized class day omits or leaks shared topic/practical/homework material; GREEN: permitted teacher/student/parent sees the common lesson material through Lesson Context; artifact: .tasks/TASK-014-T3-FT-003-W8/ and .protocols/TASK-014-T3-FT-003-W8/verification.md.

FT-003-AC-004 RED: personal view duplicates/changes shared material, includes another student's data, or cannot consume the authorized lesson-scoped grade projection; GREEN: the same lesson material is reused, Learning Progress receives lessonId plus server-resolved actor/context and selects the related homework internally, and only selected student's authorized data is composed; artifact: .tasks/TASK-014-T3-FT-003-W8/ and .protocols/TASK-014-T3-FT-003-W8/verification.md.

FT-003-AC-005 RED: date/class/student context is lost during navigation or return; GREEN: date, class, and student identity survive the transition and return to the corresponding shared day; artifact: .tasks/TASK-014-T3-FT-003-W8/ and .protocols/TASK-014-T3-FT-003-W8/verification.md.

FT-003-AC-006 RED: guessed URL/UI access returns another student's grade, discussion, or financial data; GREEN: server-side role/membership/student checks deny the request and no private data crosses context; artifact: .tasks/TASK-014-T3-FT-003-W8/ and .protocols/TASK-014-T3-FT-003-W8/verification.md.
purpose: Complete the Lesson Context orchestration boundary over all accepted provider projections.
success_outcome: Authorized users receive the correct shared/personal day view, context transitions are stable, and no other student's private data can be reached through UI or guessed URL.
anti_goals: Do not write progress, collaboration, financial, or scheduling state from Lesson Context.
Do not trust client-supplied student or role context.
Do not resolve, invent, persist, or query by homeworkId in Lesson Context; pass lessonId and server-resolved actor/context to Learning Progress.
constraints: Lesson Context is the orchestration owner and consumes only named public boundaries.
Every protected read combines actor facts with provider-owned resource scope.
Lesson Context passes stable lessonId and server-resolved actor/context to the authorized Learning Progress query; the provider selects the related homework internally.
invariants: Shared material is reused, not duplicated into personal state.
Personal data never crosses selected-student authorization.
Learning Progress owns lesson-to-homework selection/relation semantics and the lesson-scoped grade projection.
verification_targets: FT-003-AC-003: role-based shared-day smoke for teacher/student/parent with common material assertions.

FT-003-AC-004: selected-student personal-day composition with shared-material identity plus an authorized Learning Progress lesson-scoped grade query receiving lessonId and server-resolved actor/context; no consumer homework mapping.
FT-003-AC-005: class/personal navigation smoke with exact date/class/student URL or session context preservation and return path.
FT-003-AC-006: guessed-student and cross-context negative authorization checks for grade, discussion, and financial projection, plus non-mutation comparison.

stop_conditions: Stop if implementation would change the accepted provider contract or cross-slice ownership; route to /spec-design.
